assumption: LangGraphParityRuntimeV2 becomes opt-in backend via AGENT_V2_BACKEND flag; get_agent_runtime_v2() returns LangGraphParityRuntimeV2 when flag is set; default remains NativeAgentRuntimeV2.

matrix.current_native_behavior: Returns {ok, canonical_agent_v2, route, run_id, final_answer, provider_metadata, capability_metadata, mode_*, mode_escalation_*, approval_required, confirmation_id, required_permission, expected_write_scope, trace_url, blocked_tools, intent_route, intent_detected, intent_confidence}.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: Returns similar state dict but missing expected_write_scope and auto_decision; provider_metadata uses deterministic/injected finalizer source; capability_metadata contains extra parity keys.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: Adapter in api_adapter.py or wrapper in runtime selector must normalize response: add expected_write_scope from scheduled write tools, add auto_decision='n/a' fallback, preserve all fields consumed by UI.
matrix.recommendation: Add response normalization contract before flag activation; write schema parity tests.

matrix.current_native_behavior: Sends POST /v2/chat/agent; renders final_answer, metadata line, escalation panel, execution trace, legacy tool/approval cards based on response fields.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: Same endpoint; final_answer is deterministic parity summary; metadata line shows model_used='parity_v1_full' and provider source; escalation panel depends on expected_write_scope being present.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: Ensure /v2/chat/agent response includes all fields used by ui/index.html: expected_write_scope, required_permission, confirmation_id, trace_url, mode_escalation_required.
matrix.recommendation: Contract test through TestClient with monkeypatched finalizer to verify schema.

matrix.current_native_behavior: dashboard_routes.py:313 proxies POST to 127.0.0.1:8091/v2/chat/agent and maps response to dashboard fields including content, run_id, trace_url, mode_effective, expected_write_scope.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: Proxy still works if /v2/chat/agent response schema is normalized. dashboard_routes.py already maps many fields but requires expected_write_scope and auto_decision.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: Schema normalization at /v2/chat/agent; verify dashboard proxy sees expected fields; verify service on 8091 uses same backend as 8090.
matrix.recommendation: Add dashboard proxy contract tests before wiring.

matrix.current_native_behavior: dashboard/static/app.js:279 fetches /brain-dashboard/agent-v2/runs/{run_id}/trace and filters events by event_type: plan_created, tool_call_started, tool_call_completed.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: LangGraph emits node-based trace events: start_node, intent_node, context_assembly, memory_retrieval, evidence_routing, planner_node, governance_gate, tool_execution_node, result_normalization, finalizer_node, evaluator_node, repair_or_replan, capability_metadata_node, end_node. Plan/Tools/Evidence sections may be empty.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: Either (a) LangGraph runtime must emit Native-equivalent trace event types, or (b) dashboard JS must be taught to render node-based events. Option (a) is safer and does not change frontend files.
matrix.recommendation: Add trace event type adapter in LangGraph runtime or runtime wrapper before wiring.

matrix.current_native_behavior: Consumes /brain/agent-trace/latest and /brain/agent-trace/stream. Filters by type: thinking, tool, evidence, governance, etc. Not dependent on runtime.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: Transport unaffected. If LangGraph runtime emits internal events via main.py emitters, event types could differ, but endpoint is runtime-independent.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: Verify no regression in visual trace console when /v2/chat/agent is exercised under LangGraph.
matrix.recommendation: No wiring blocker, but regression test recommended.

matrix.current_native_behavior: api_adapter.py constructs trace_url = f'/v2/agent/runs/{run_id}/trace'. Native stores trace.jsonl under RUN_ROOT.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: Same trace_url format. LangGraph stores trace under self.run_root (default tmp_agent/agent_kernel_v2/runs_parity). If run_root differs, trace endpoint may 404.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: Ensure LangGraph backend uses same run_root as Native when opt-in flag is active, or api_adapter trace endpoint resolves run_id across both roots.
matrix.recommendation: Unify run_root for opt-in backend or implement dual-root trace lookup.

matrix.current_native_behavior: Native generates agv2_ prefix via hash of goal+timestamp+user_id.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: LangGraph uses same prefix and similar hash in _new_run_id. run_id format compatible.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: Verify run_id regex/parsing in dashboard still works.
matrix.recommendation: No action required.

matrix.current_native_behavior: api_adapter.py _build_capability_metadata derives memory_used, retrieval_*, planner_used, evidence_*, tools_*, governance_checked, intent_route, classification.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: LangGraph _build_capability_metadata returns superset including deep parity keys. All required keys present.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: Ensure api_adapter.py required keys remain present; UI does not use deep parity keys.
matrix.recommendation: No action required; extra keys are safe.

matrix.current_native_behavior: provider_metadata from finalize_agent_run contains provider_used, model_used, provider_degraded, fallback_reason.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: LangGraph sets provider_used=finalizer_source, model_used='parity_v1_full', live_llm_called=false, provider_degraded=false. UI will display different strings.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: If injecting live LLM finalizer, provider_metadata should mirror native shape; if deterministic, dashboard must tolerate parity labels.
matrix.recommendation: Document parity labels in dashboard or inject finalizer for production-like behavior.

matrix.current_native_behavior: Native validates mode and blocks write tools via ToolGatewayV2.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: LangGraph _governance_gate_node and _tool_execution_node block write tools in read_only using same governance helpers.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: Existing governance tests suffice; add frontend contract test.
matrix.recommendation: No action required.

matrix.current_native_behavior: Native uses mode_requires_escalation and generates expected_write_scope, required_permission='build', confirmation_id.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: LangGraph computes mode_escalation_required and confirmation_id, but does NOT produce expected_write_scope or integrate with /gate/approve. Write tools outside SUPPORTED_READ_TOOLS are marked 'unsupported_tool_in_parity' and skipped.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: Add expected_write_scope generation in LangGraph; ensure build mode UX degrades gracefully or blocks safely.
matrix.recommendation: Build mode is a blocking gap. Either limit opt-in to read_only/dry_run until fixed, or implement expected_write_scope + write tool handling.

matrix.current_native_behavior: Native create_run calls infer_auto_decision and returns auto_decision in response.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: LangGraph does not implement infer_auto_decision; auto_decision would be missing. UI shows 'n/a' only if present.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: Response normalization must add auto_decision='n/a' or implement infer_auto_decision in LangGraph.
matrix.recommendation: Add auto_decision to normalized response.

matrix.current_native_behavior: Native returns mode_escalation_required and approval_required semantics via expected_write_scope/confirmation_id.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: LangGraph sets mode_escalation_required=True and approval_required=True for write tools, but no actionable /gate/approve integration.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: Frontend escalation panel must receive expected_write_scope and confirmation_id. No /gate integration needed for read-only display.
matrix.recommendation: Ensure expected_write_scope is populated.

matrix.current_native_behavior: Native generates confirmation_id = f'confirm_{run_id}' and uses it for build escalation.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: LangGraph also generates confirmation_id = f'confirm_{run_id}'. Format compatible.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: Verify UI receives confirmation_id when mode_escalation_required is true.
matrix.recommendation: No action required if expected_write_scope is added.

matrix.current_native_behavior: Native sets required_permission='build' for escalation.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: LangGraph sets required_permission='build' in _governance_gate_node.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: Existing behavior.
matrix.recommendation: No action required.

matrix.current_native_behavior: Native stores tool results in run.plan[].output and passes to finalizer.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: LangGraph stores tool_results in state['tool_results'] and step outputs. Not exposed directly in /v2/chat/agent response, but capability_metadata summarizes.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: UI does not directly consume tool_results array from /v2/chat/agent today.
matrix.recommendation: No action required unless future UI depends on raw tool_results.

matrix.current_native_behavior: api_adapter.py returns blocked_tools list from run.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: LangGraph appends blocked tool names to state['blocked_tools']; api_adapter reads run.get('blocked_tools') so it will work.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: Verify list shape is same.
matrix.recommendation: No action required.

matrix.current_native_behavior: /v2/chat/agent is synchronous JSON. Visual progress comes from /brain/agent-trace/stream which is independent of runtime.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: Same synchronous JSON. LangGraph graph.stream exists in probe only; no production streaming wiring.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: No streaming contract required for /v2/chat/agent today.
matrix.recommendation: Document non-streaming status; optional future work.

matrix.current_native_behavior: /v2/agent/status returns backend='native_runtime'. /brain-dashboard/status agent_v2 block shows backend and latest_provider_used.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: backend becomes 'langgraph_parity'. latest_provider_used becomes deterministic finalizer source. Status panels tolerate string change.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: Verify dashboard does not hardcode backend string.
matrix.recommendation: No action required.

matrix.current_native_behavior: Native execute_run catches exceptions, saves status='failed', returns run dict. api_adapter returns JSON.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: If langgraph package unavailable, LangGraph run() returns dict without run_id/trace_url, which could break api_adapter response construction.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: api_adapter must handle LangGraph unavailability gracefully; runtime selector should not return LangGraph if env flag is not set or package missing.
matrix.recommendation: Guard opt-in wiring: only activate if langgraph available and flag explicitly set; otherwise fallback to Native.

matrix.current_native_behavior: POST /chat uses handle_user_message -> BrainSession.chat.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: Unchanged. Legacy chat does not touch Agent V2 runtime.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: none
matrix.recommendation: No action required.

matrix.current_native_behavior: POST /v1/chat/completions uses handle_user_message -> BrainSession.chat.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: Unchanged. OpenAI adapter does not touch Agent V2 runtime.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: none
matrix.recommendation: No action required.

matrix.current_native_behavior: Dashboard 8092 assumes Agent V2 backend is reachable on 127.0.0.1:8091.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: Proxy still works as long as 8091 exposes /v2/chat/agent. If opt-in wiring is only on 8090 but 8091 runs Native, dashboard chat will not use LangGraph. If 8091 runs LangGraph, schema/trace path must be preserved.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: Document that 8091 and 8090 must use same backend selection logic when flag is active; ensure dashboard proxy works.
matrix.recommendation: Add contract test exercising dashboard proxy against both Native and LangGraph backends.

matrix.current_native_behavior: Native stores runs/traces under RUN_ROOT (tmp_agent/brain_v9/state.py).
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: LangGraph defaults to tmp_agent/agent_kernel_v2/runs_parity.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: Opt-in wiring must pass same run_root to LangGraphParityRuntimeV2 as Native RUN_ROOT, or api_adapter trace endpoint must search both roots.
matrix.recommendation: Use production RUN_ROOT for opt-in backend.

matrix.current_native_behavior: Native uses TraceStore and CheckpointStore under RUN_ROOT.
matrix.langgraph_expected_behavior: LangGraph uses same TraceStore/CheckpointStore classes but under different run_root by default.
matrix.required_adapter_or_test: Ensure same run_root or implement trace resolution adapter.
matrix.recommendation: Unify storage root.
